functions.name: submit

signature.return_type: Promise<{ success: true; data: T } | { success: false; error: string }>

side_effects: Dedupe keying: - with options.dedupeKey = "k": submission key is exact string "submission:k". - without dedupe key: unique Symbol("submission").
Existing dedupe-keyed submission is aborted before starting replacement submission.
Always returns union shape; does not throw for network and HTTP failures from internal flow.
On abort error: { success: false, error: "Aborted" }.
On HTTP non-OK or missing response: { success: false, error: String(status || "unknown") }.
On non-abort thrown error: { success: false, error: error.message | "Unknown error" }.
On redirect with redirectData.status === "should": performs redirect effect and returns { success: true, data: undefined as T }.
Auto-revalidation after successful non-GET submission when redirect status is not "did" and options.revalidate !== false.

params.name: options
params.type: { vormaAppConfig: VormaAppConfig; renderFn: () => void; defaultErrorBoundary?: RouteErrorComponent; useViewTransitions?: boolean }

Awaits in order: initial component load, client loader setup, error-boundary component resolution.

Adds one-shot touchstart listener that sets isTouchDevice = true.

normative_statements.text: submit MUST return one of two shapes only: { success: true, data } or { success: false, error }.
With options.dedupeKey, submit MUST abort an existing in-flight submission for the same key before starting the new one.
Without options.dedupeKey, submissions MUST be tracked independently.
submit MUST attach x-deployment-id header when global deployment ID exists.
submit MUST call redirect handler with isPrefetch: false and redirectCount: 0.
Non-OK or missing response MUST return { success: false, error: String(status || "unknown") }.
Redirect result with status "should" MUST trigger redirect effectuation and return success with data set to undefined value.
Successful non-GET submission MUST trigger revalidate() unless redirect status is "did" or options.revalidate === false.
Abort errors MUST map to exact error string "Aborted".

normative_statements.text: initClient MUST initialize HMR first.
initClient MUST attach a beforeunload listener that saves page-refresh scroll state.
initClient MUST set vormaAppConfig global key to provided config.
initClient MUST rebuild and store clientModuleMap from initial SSR route arrays, defaulting missing export key to "default" and missing error export key to empty string.
initClient MUST initialize pattern registry with loader runes from vormaAppConfig.
If routeManifestURL exists, initClient MUST asynchronously fetch manifest and register all manifest patterns.
initClient MUST set default error boundary to user-provided callback when given, else package defaultErrorBoundary.
initClient MUST set useViewTransitions only when option is truthy.
initClient MUST initialize history and enforce manual scroll restoration.
If URL contains vorma_reload, initClient MUST remove that query param and replace URL via history.
initClient MUST await initial component resolution, client loader setup, and error boundary component resolution, then execute renderFn.
initClient MUST attempt page-refresh scroll restoration after rendering.
initClient MUST install one-time touchstart listener that sets global isTouchDevice to true.

normative_statements.text: __getPrefetchHandlers MUST return undefined for external or non-HTTP hrefs and for missing dependency-relative URL.
__getPrefetchHandlers MUST use 100 ms default prefetch delay when delayMs is omitted.
start() MUST schedule exactly one prefetch start per handler instance until stopped/reset.
stop() MUST clear pending timer and abort/remove prefetch navigation entry when entry type is prefetch and intent is none.

onClick() on prefetch handler MUST: - return early when event already prevented or ineligible anchor details. - for hash-only same-page change, save scroll state and MUST NOT start fetch navigation. - for eligible internal links, prevent default, run callbacks in order (beforeBegin only when prefetch not already started, then beforeRender, then navigation, then afterRender).

__makeLinkOnClickFn returned function MUST: - ignore already prevented and ineligible events. - perform hash-only save-scroll shortcut. - for eligible internal links, prevent default, run beforeBegin, begin user navigation, then handle outcome: - aborted: remove navigation. - redirect: run beforeRender, remove navigation, effectuate redirect, run afterRender. - success: run beforeRender, process navigation when entry exists, run afterRender.

normative_statements.text: setupGlobalLoadingIndicator MUST default startDelayMS and stopDelayMS to 12 when omitted.
Include behavior MUST be: - include omitted or "all": all three status dimensions (isNavigating, isSubmitting, isRevalidating) considered. - include array: only listed dimensions considered.
Setup MUST evaluate current status immediately once.
If working state becomes true: - stop timer MUST be cleared. - start timer MUST schedule at startDelayMS and call start() only when indicator not running and working state still true.
If working state becomes false: - start timer MUST be cleared. - stop timer MUST schedule at stopDelayMS and call stop() only when indicator running and working state still false.
Returned cleanup MUST remove status listener, clear timers, and call stop() when indicator remains running.

normative_statements.text: Export binding __runClientLoadersAfterHMRUpdate MUST be a no-op function before dev HMR initialization.

During initClient execution, HMR init MUST configure dev-mode behavior: - assign a development-only revalidation hook on window that invokes package revalidate. - set internal debounced client-loader rerun function with delay 10 ms. - replace exported __runClientLoadersAfterHMRUpdate with dev implementation.
Dev implementation MUST register at most one vite:afterUpdate listener per current module pathname.
On matching JS update and when current matched patterns include requested pattern, dev implementation MUST invoke debounced client-loader setup and dispatch route-change event.

Returned dataExternal MUST be prefetchObj.isExternal when prefetch object exists, otherwise undefined.
Pointer/focus handlers MUST call prefetch start before user handler (when user handler exists and is function).
onPointerLeave MUST NOT stop prefetch on touch devices (__vormaClientGlobal.get("isTouchDevice") truthy); it MUST stop otherwise.
onBlur and onTouchCancel MUST stop prefetch.
Returned onClick MUST call user onClick first, then: - if prefetch object exists: await prefetchObj.onClick(e). - else: await click handler from __makeLinkOnClickFn.
Custom handler key mapping via keys argument MUST be honored.

normative_statements.text: __resolvePath MUST: - start from props.pattern. - replace dynamic placeholders using configured rune set (actions* for query/mutation; loaders* for loader). - replace splat rune with splatValues.join("/") when provided. - for loader type, strip trailing /${loadersExplicitIndexSegment} when present; if full path becomes empty, return /.
buildQueryURL and buildMutationURL MUST build absolute URL using origin from window.location.href and base path stripTrailingSlash(actionsRouterMountRoot).
buildQueryURL MUST set URL search from dependency serializer only when props.input is truthy.
buildMutationURL MUST NOT add query string from props.input.
resolveBody MUST pass through null, undefined, string, Blob, FormData, URLSearchParams, ReadableStream, ArrayBuffer, and typed-array views unchanged.
resolveBody MUST JSON stringify all other values.
